exposure: digital storytelling of peers' childbirth experiences
cohort: Pregnant individuals birthing for the first time from four comprehensive health centers participated in the study.
finding: Digital storytelling of peers' childbirth experiences was effective in cultivating more positive perceptions of childbirth, specifically among those who experienced vaginal birth.
mod_finding: While mode of childbirth was a primary outcome, the study did not report a significant effect of the intervention on the overall rate of cesarean sections.
